actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.generate_content.description: Call a Gemini model on Vertex AI to generate a text response.
actions.generate_content.props.files.des: Optional files to include in the prompt (images, PDFs, text, audio, video)
actions.generate_content.props.imageUrls: Public image URLs to include alongside the user message. The model will analyze these images.
actions.generate_content.props.includeTh: When enabled, the model's reasoning is returned alongside the final response. Supported on Gemini 2.5 and later models.
Google Cloud region where your Vertex AI resources are hosted.
actions.generate_content.props.maxOutput: Maximum number of tokens to generate. Leave empty to use the model default.
actions.generate_content.props.model.des: Gemini model to use for content generation.
actions.generate_content.props.systemMes: Instructions that guide the model's behavior throughout the conversation.
actions.generate_content.props.temperatu: Controls randomness. Lower values are more deterministic (0–2). Leave empty to use the model default.
actions.generate_content.props.thinkingB: Maximum number of tokens the model can use for internal reasoning. Set to 0 to disable thinking. Supported on Gemini 2.5 and later models.
actions.generate_content.props.thinkingL: Controls how much the model thinks before responding. Supported on Gemini 2.5 and later models.
actions.generate_content.props.userMessa: The prompt to send to the model.
actions.generate_content.props.youtubeUr: Optional public YouTube video URL for the AI to use as a reference.
actions.generate_image.description: Generate an image from a text prompt using Google Imagen models on Vertex AI.
actions.generate_image.props.location.de: Google Cloud region where your Vertex AI resources are hosted.
actions.generate_image.props.model.descr: Model to use for image generation.
actions.generate_image.props.prompt.desc: A text description of the image you want to generate.
auth.description:
To authenticate with Google Vertex AI using a Service Account:
  1. Go to [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com).
  2. Create a new project or select an existing one.
  3. Enable the **Vertex AI API** under *APIs & Services > Enabled APIs*.
  4. Create a Service Account:
     - Go to **IAM & Admin > Service Accounts**.
     - Click **Create Service Account**, fill in the details and click **Create**.
     - Grant the **Vertex AI User** role.
  5. Create a JSON key:
     - Click on the created service account.
     - Go to the **Keys** tab.
     - Click **Add Key > Create new key**, choose **JSON** and click **Create**.
     - The JSON key file will be downloaded automatically.
  6. Copy the **entire contents** of the downloaded JSON file and paste it below.
auth.props.serviceAccountJson.descriptio: The complete JSON content from your Google Service Account key file.
